title: 37th Bangkok Marathon 2027 Review: Starting Beside the Grand Palace
meta_description: 37th Bangkok Marathon 2027 review: January 10, starting on Sanam Chai Road beside the Grand Palace -- a 37-year-old race, nationwide registration opens July.
dek: Set for 10 January 2027, the 37th edition of the Bangkok Marathon starts on Sanam Chai Road directly beside the Grand Palace -- nationwide registration opens 1 July 2026, well ahead of race day.
verdict: The 37th Bangkok Marathon carries genuinely exceptional continuity: 37 consecutive editions puts it among the most established races in this entire research batch, on par with the Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon's 33 years. The start line sits directly beside Bangkok's Grand Palace, one of Thailand's most recognisable landmarks, on Sanam Chai Road. Three distances (10K/21.1K/42.195K) and a clearly announced nationwide registration date (1 July 2026) give this race genuine planning clarity, even though sign-up hasn't opened yet as of this research.

sections.heading: 37 Years of Continuous Racing
paragraphs: The 2027 race is the 37th edition of the Bangkok Marathon, offering three distances: 10K, 21.1K and the 42.195K full marathon. [1] That level of multi-decade continuity places it among the longest-running events in this entire research batch, alongside the Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon's 33rd edition covered elsewhere in this research -- genuine institutional weight built up over nearly four decades.

sections.heading: Starting Beside the Grand Palace
paragraphs: The race starts on Sanam Chai Road, directly beside Bangkok's Grand Palace -- one of Thailand's most recognisable and historically significant landmarks, the former residence of the Kings of Siam and still used for official ceremonies today. [1] Few marathons anywhere in Southeast Asia can claim a start line this iconic.

sections.heading: Nationwide Registration Timing
paragraphs: As of this writing, registration is not yet open, but organisers have already announced it will open nationwide on 1 July 2026, with a dedicated registration portal for foreign runners already live. [2] That's a clear date to plan around, unlike many races in this research batch where registration timing remains entirely unconfirmed.

sections.heading: Three Distances
paragraphs: The 10K, 21.1K half marathon and 42.195K full marathon categories give the race solid range, though notably it doesn't offer a shorter 5K fun-run option that many races in this research batch include -- suggesting a field skewed toward more experienced runners.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If a marathon with genuine 37-year history and a start line beside one of Southeast Asia's most iconic landmarks appeals, the 37th Bangkok Marathon on 10 January 2027 is one of the strongest picks in this entire research batch. Mark 1 July 2026 on your calendar for when nationwide registration opens.
